nodes.rationale: Mirrors are generated, never hand-edited: regenerating every harness file after each canonical edit, plus a byte-level --check audit that exits 1 on mismatch, prevents silent divergence between AGENTS.md, the skill copies, and the harness shims.

nodes.label: Agent-Agnostic Single-Source-of-Truth Design
nodes.community_name: Harness Entry Points, Mirrors, and Drift Control
nodes.rationale: Keeping AGENTS.md plus the canonical .agents/skills bundle as the only agent-facing sources, with every other harness file a thin import or byte-verified mirror, lets any LLM harness open the repo and follow one spec without double-reads or silent drift.

nodes.label: Vanilla Vibe Matching Paradigm (Dryxio gta-3d-ai)
nodes.community_name: Dryxio gta-3d-ai Toolchain (GTA Scout, Ariane, GTA Stuff)
nodes.rationale: The agent must never generate generic high-density AI meshes or clean synthetic textures; assets have to look like Rockstar North's 2004 gta3.img / player.img peds so the PS2 art direction, low-poly topology, and RenderWare 3.6.0.3 lighting survive when compiled for PC.

nodes.label: PS2 Topology Budget and Validator Caps
nodes.norm_label: ps2 topology budget and validator caps
nodes.rationale: The 1,600-triangle / 1,100-vertex / 1-atomic / 4-bones-per-vertex caps encode authentic 2004 PS2 ped budgets while giving validate_rw_stream.py enforceable numeric limits, so compiled skins stay visually period-correct instead of drifting toward modern high-density meshes.
